title: Regulated Activity Classifier — Output
description: Classification record flagging whether an expense implicates an activity that requires institutional compliance oversight — human subjects (IRB), animals (IACUC), or biosafety (IBC). Detection-layer contract for the federal cost-allowability analysis workflow.

triggered.description: True when the expense plausibly implicates this regulated activity.

trigger_signals.description: Concrete expense signals relied on. Empty array when not triggered.

expense_id.description: Expense reference carried from the input.

any_regime_triggered.description: True when at least one regime is triggered.

summary.description: One-sentence statement of flagged regimes and what to verify next.
